question1: How do I upload a new receipt?
answer1: Go to the Add New Receipt page, click the Upload button or drag & drop your image/PDF file, fill in the receipt details (Vendor, Amount, Date, Category, Notes), then click Submit.
question2: How do I edit a receipt after uploading it?
answer2: Open the Receipt Details page, click Edit, update the necessary information, and click Save to update the receipt.
answer3: Yes. From the Receipt Details page or the receipt table, click Delete, and confirm the deletion to remove the receipt permanently.
question4: What file formats are supported for receipts?
answer4: The system supports JPG / PNG / PDF files. Make sure the file size is under 5MB for a successful upload.
answer5: Yes. Click the Export button on the Receipts List page and select PDF / CSV / Excel to download your receipts.
question6: How do I change my password?
answer6: Go to Profile Settings, click Change Password, and follow the steps to enter your old and new password.
question7: What do the receipt statuses (Pending / Approved / Rejected) mean?
answer7: Pending: The receipt has been uploaded but not reviewed yet. Approved: The receipt has been verified and approved. Rejected: The receipt was rejected due to incomplete details or unclear image.

cards.clutter_desc: Receipts scattered across emails, wallets, and drawers. Physical receipts fade, get lost, or become unreadable when you need them most.

cards.storage_desc: Physical receipts takes up space and make it difficult to find purchases when you need them - for returns, warranties, or records.
cards.environment_desc: Billions of paper receipts contribute to deforestation and waste. Most receipts contain harmful chemicals that are not eco-friendly and can't be recycled.
